fields.summary: After the owner asked what was left to build and said to keep going, the orchestrator planned milestone 18 from the small contained items left in the Area umbrellas. hook-commands (hook ls and hook run) finishes the hooks area begun by the notify hook and the lifecycle event hooks; it can be carved before the event hooks land because its change set depends on theirs, so the carve's what-if view includes its parent. Today hook ls could not see a running daemon's flags, since the daemon's state keeps only which items it handled, so the daemon records its commands and their sources. Notes on a change (decision notes-are-discussion) need storage: a new note node kind with a discusses link to anything is the smallest fit (adding the anchor kind touched four Go files), whereas reusing relates-to would blur its meaning and a new entry type would change folding; ops are not link endpoints, so a note on an op links to its change set and names the op. Actor stamping, also listed, is already landed (actor-stamping and launch-env-stamping), so it is dropped.
fields.title: Milestone 18: test your hooks, discuss a change
